thiruvananthapuram.name: Thiruvananthapuram (Trivandrum)
thiruvananthapuram.alias: The Royal Abode · Capital of Kerala
thiruvananthapuram.highlightText: Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple (Flynova Temple Package endpoint), Kovalam & Varkala.
thiruvananthapuram.title: Sacred Wealth, Royal Palaces and Sunlit Cliffs
thiruvananthapuram.description: The capital city and a key highlight of Flynova's 5-day temple tour. Home to the world's richest temple — Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple, the cliff-top vistas of Varkala, and the golden shores of Kovalam.
flynovaPackages: Madurai - Rameshwaram - Kanyakumari - Trivandrum Temple Yatra (5D/4N)
Kovalam Beach & Luxury Ayurvedic Spa Retreat (4D/3N)
Varkala Cliff Sunset & Sree Padmanabhaswamy VIP Darshan

idukki.name: Idukki (Munnar)
idukki.highlightText: Featured in Flynova hero; Munnar tea estates, Anamudi peak & Periyar wildlife.
idukki.title: Misty Valleys, Tea Plantations and Wild Reserves
idukki.description: One of the most elevated and spectacular districts in South India. Over 50% covered in dense forests, including Munnar’s endless green tea gardens, Kolukkumalai highest tea estate, and Thekkady Periyar Tiger Reserve.
flynovaPackages: Munnar Misty Tea Hills Luxury Getaway (3D/2N)
Thekkady Spice Plantation & Periyar Boat Safari
Munnar & Alleppey Houseboat Honeymoon Signature (5D/4N)

palakkad.name: Palakkad
palakkad.alias: Gateway of Kerala · Granary of God's Own Country
palakkad.highlightText: Mountain gap between Kerala and Tamil Nadu, Silent Valley rainforest, and Tipu's Fort.
palakkad.title: The Mountain Pass of Lush Green Paddy Fields
palakkad.description: Famous for the 30-km Palakkad Gap in the Western Ghats, ancient granite fortresses, peacock sanctuaries, and the untouched virgin rainforest of Silent Valley.
flynovaPackages: Silent Valley Wilderness & Rainforest Safari (3D/2N)
Palakkad Heritage Fortress & Village Agro-Tour

kollam.name: Kollam
kollam.highlightText: Ashtamudi Lake (8-armed lagoon), Munroe Island canal walks & cashew hub.
kollam.title: Ancient Harbor and Ashtamudi Waterways
kollam.description: An ancient international port that traded with Rome, China, and Arabia. Renowned for Ashtamudi Lake with its eight branches, Munroe Island country boat rides, and the Palaruvi waterfall.
flynovaPackages: Munroe Island Country Canoe & Village Life Experience
Ashtamudi Lake Houseboat & Resort Holiday

pathanamthitta.name: Pathanamthitta
pathanamthitta.highlightText: Sabarimala hill temple, Aranmula metal mirrors & holy Pamba river.
pathanamthitta.title: Sanctuary of Faith, Forests and Metal Craft
pathanamthitta.description: Dense forest mountains, the holy river Pamba, and the world-renowned Sabarimala pilgrimage shrine. Famous for the unique UNESCO-recognized Aranmula Kannadi (metal alloy mirror).
flynovaPackages: Gavi Rainforest & Eco-Tourism Jeep Safari
Sabarimala & South Kerala Temple Pilgrimage Circuit

thrissur.name: Thrissur
thrissur.highlightText: Home to the world-famous Thrissur Pooram festival, Guruvayur Temple, and Athirappilly Falls.
thrissur.title: Sacred Shrines, Classical Arts and Thunderous Falls
thrissur.description: Centered around the hillock shrine of Vadakkunnathan. Close to Guruvayur Sree Krishna Temple, Kerala Kalamandalam classical arts academy, and the Niagara of India — Athirappilly Waterfalls.
flynovaPackages: Athirappilly Falls & Rainforest Luxury Resort (3D/2N)
Guruvayur & Sacred Central Kerala Temple Darshan

malappuram.name: Malappuram
malappuram.highlightText: World's oldest teak plantation at Nilambur and sacred cultural heritage.
malappuram.title: Rolling Hills, Rivers and Royal Teak Forests
malappuram.description: Bounded by the Arabian Sea on the west and the Nilgiri hills on the east. Highlights include the Conolly's Plot teak museum, Kadalundi bird sanctuary, and Kottakkal Arya Vaidya Sala.
flynovaPackages: Nilambur Teak Heritage & Rainforest Walk
Authentic Kerala Ayurveda Rejuvenation Package

wayanad.name: Wayanad
wayanad.highlightText: Misty mountain plateau, prehistoric Edakkal rock carvings & treehouse stays.
wayanad.title: Emerald Heights of the Western Ghats
wayanad.description: Elevated high above the plains with coffee plantations, cool waterfalls, Chembra Heart Lake, and wild elephant corridors in Muthanga.
flynovaPackages: Wayanad Mist & Treehouse Wilderness Retreat (4D/3N)
Edakkal Cave Heritage & Chembra Peak Trek

kannur.name: Kannur
kannur.highlightText: Asia's longest drive-in beach, handloom traditions, and St. Angelo Fort.
kannur.title: The Land of Looms and Lore
kannur.description: Famous for the 4 km drive-in sands of Muzhappilangad, Portuguese stone bastion St. Angelo Fort, and vibrant village shrines with night fire dances.
flynovaPackages: Malabar Coastal Culture & Drive-in Beach Tour
Theyyam Fire Dance & Heritage Circuit

kasaragod.name: Kasaragod
kasaragod.highlightText: Northernmost coastal tip with historic sea fortresses & Theyyam rituals.
kasaragod.title: Forts, Tides & Ancient Sacred Rites
kasaragod.description: Home to the monumental Bekal Fort perched over Arabian Sea waves, sacred Ananthapura Lake Temple, and centuries-old Theyyam temple rituals.
flynovaPackages: Bekal Luxury Sea-Cliff Retreat (3D/2N)
North Kerala Sacred Theyyam & Temple Trail

kozhikode.name: Kozhikode
kozhikode.highlightText: Where Vasco da Gama landed in 1498; legendary culinary spice capital.
kozhikode.title: Historic Port of Global Trade & Flavors
kozhikode.description: Celebrated for its historic trade wharfs, century-old sweetmeat street (SM Street), legendary Malabar biryani, and pristine Beypore dhow shipbuilding.
flynovaPackages: Malabar Culinary & Spice Route Expedition
Beypore Heritage Dhow & Kappad Beach Trail

ernakulam.name: Ernakulam (Kochi)
ernakulam.alias: Queen of the Arabian Sea · Flynova HQ
ernakulam.highlightText: Flynova Reisen LLP registered office; Cochin International Airport, Fort Kochi & Marina.
ernakulam.title: Cosmopolitan Gateway & Maritime Heritage
ernakulam.description: The commercial heart of Kerala and headquarters of Flynova Reisen LLP (Ayyapankavu, Ernakulam). Features 500-year-old colonial bungalows, Chinese fishing nets, Jewish Synagogue, and luxury backwater yachting.
flynovaPackages: Fort Kochi Colonial Heritage & Sunset Harbor Cruise
Kochi Arrival Concierge & VIP Chauffeured Transfers
Kerala Grand Panorama: Kochi to Munnar & Alleppey (6D/5N)

alappuzha.name: Alappuzha (Alleppey)
alappuzha.highlightText: Primary hero showcase; luxury kettuvallam houseboats & tranquil palm canals.
alappuzha.title: The Soul of Kerala's Serene Backwaters
alappuzha.description: A labyrinth of palm-fringed lagoons, emerald paddy fields below sea level (Kuttanad), and tranquil waterways where Flynova’s private luxury houseboats glide with private onboard chefs.
flynovaPackages: Alleppey Luxury Houseboat Overnight Cruise with Private Chef
Romantic Kerala Backwater Honeymoon Haven (4D/3N)
Marari Beach & Backwater Serenity Retreat

kottayam.name: Kottayam
kottayam.highlightText: Kumarakom bird sanctuary, Vembanad luxury resorts & spice hills.
kottayam.title: Vembanad Lakeside and Rubber Plantations
kottayam.description: Perched along the eastern shore of Vembanad Lake. Home to the migratory Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary, centuries-old Syrian Christian churches, and scenic heritage lakeside luxury villas.
flynovaPackages: Kumarakom Lakeside Luxury Resort & Ayurvedic Spa
Vembanad Sunset Cruise & Bird Watching Trail
